name: task-management-frontend
description: Task Management System Frontend with Webpack Module Federation

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd shell-app && npm install && cd ../microfrontends/user-app && npm install && cd ../task-app && npm install && cd ../notification-app && npm install && cd ../shared-components && npm install
scripts.start:all: concurrently "npm run start:shell" "npm run start:user" "npm run start:task" "npm run start:notification" "npm run start:shared"
scripts.build:all: cd shell-app && npm run build && cd ../microfrontends/user-app && npm run build && cd ../task-app && npm run build && cd ../notification-app && npm run build && cd ../shared-components && npm run build
scripts.analyze:shell: cd shell-app && npm run build && npx webpack-bundle-analyzer dist/static/js/*.js
scripts.analyze:user: cd microfrontends/user-app && npm run build && npx webpack-bundle-analyzer dist/static/js/*.js
scripts.analyze:task: cd microfrontends/task-app && npm run build && npx webpack-bundle-analyzer dist/static/js/*.js
scripts.analyze:notification: cd microfrontends/notification-app && npm run build && npx webpack-bundle-analyzer dist/static/js/*.js
scripts.analyze:all: npm run analyze:shell & npm run analyze:user & npm run analyze:task & npm run analyze:notification
